mathematical_definition: Numba kernel high_low_density(high, low, window=60): fraction of the trailing 60 bars whose [low,high] range overlaps the current bar's [low,high] range -- a purely statistical price-congestion proxy, not a hardcoded support/resistance rule
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 60 bars (kernel loop starts at window=60), never zero-filled
